 Order

Dated this the 9th day of October, 2024 This Criminal Miscellaneous Case has been filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, by the petitioners, to quash Annexure A1 Final Report in C.C.No.370/2023 on the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Kalpetta, arose out of Crime No.618/2023 of Kalpetta police station, Wayanad, and all further proceedings thereunder.
The petitioners herein are accused Nos.2 to 5 in the above case.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioners, the learned counsel appearing for the de facto complainant and the learned Public Prosecutor.
3.
In this matter, offence punishable under Section 498A r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, is alleged to have been committed by the accused.

3. In this matter, parties referred to mediation to be 2024:KER:76263 done at Medication Centre attached to the District Court, Kalpetta and as per mediation agreement, dated 7.10.2024, the matter has been settled between the parties.

As per the terms of the mediation agreement, it was decided to withdraw C.C.No.370/2023 on the files of the Chief Judicial Magistrate Court, Kalpetta and also M.C.No.133/2024 filed, claiming maintenance.

4. Since the matter has been settled between the parties as per the terms of the mediation agreement, dated 7.10.2024, there is no reason to disallow the prayer for quashment, so as to facilitate peaceful living of the parties hereinafter.
Therefore, in the interest of justice, I am inclined to allow this petition.
In the result, this petition stands allowed.

2 police station, Wayanad, and all further proceedings thereunder, against the petitioners herein,
2024:KER:76263 stand quashed.
